benchmark: QAngaroo WikiHop v1.1 official dev split
support_metric_limitation: Official WikiHop dev annotations expose relation patterns, not gold supporting source sentence indices.
control: MiniLM sentence-atom rank with candidate-aware verifier and reader
treatment: Phase28 semantic-joint-citations with candidate-aware verifier and reader
hypothesis: Providing the benchmark candidate answer list to the verifier will reduce intermediate-entity citation choices and make semantic selection improve EM.
reader_change: Both arms receive benchmark candidate answer strings; verifier also receives the same candidate list. No answer or annotation field is sent.
